text:
Iris - People Ops: Quick drop  tiny pack of ultra-short goal+feedback tiles you can paste in 1:1s or comments. Keep each entry to 1-3 lines.

Diego - Eng Manager: Perfect. Please add a single-line prompt for linking artifacts.

Iris - People Ops: Added. Also a one-line confidence marker (high/med/low).

Sophie - SWE: Love the concise bits. Useful for async reviews.

hr-bot: Reminder: mid-cycle check-ins open next Monday (link in calendar).

--- paste-ready tiles ---

IC micro-review (1-2 lines):
Top outcome: shipped feature X; adoption 12% in cohort; PR #911 linked.
What I learned / next: simplified retry logic -> fewer flakes. confidence: med

IC platform note (1 line):
Outcome: reduced p95 from 310ms -> 260ms; estimated $4k/mo saved; issue #422. confidence: high

IC growth prompt (1 line):
Skill built: led postmortem on infra flakiness; next step: mentor on on-call runbook. confidence: low

Peer feedback (one-liner):
Great cross-team partner: clarified requirements, prevented two regressions.

Manager quick check (2 lines):
Observed: removed blocker on infra deploy; enabled feature rollout.
Ask: escalate if >3 blocked tasks externally; propose mitigation.

Manager async note (1 line):
Nice work on reducing deploy pain  link PR/issue when possible for calibration.

Simple confidence guide (inline): high = likely done, med = needs 1-2 syncs, low = needs scope change/blocker removal

--- manager blurb to share with ICs (one para) ---
Iris - People Ops: Use these tiles to keep check-ins short and focused: outcomes, learning, and asks. Please link PRs/issues and use the confidence tag so we can triage support quickly; follow up in 1:1 for details.

Diego - Eng Manager: I'll add these to our team 1:1 template. Thanks! :raised_hands:

Iris - People Ops: Cool  ping me if you want level-specific variants or a Confluence snippet.
